searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) on 'huon pine slab': 898 sales, median $55, high end $155-170 for single long slabs (note: the pipeline database also holds lines marked 'listed 202x' that are estimates, ignored). Gowans API search 'huon pine' pages 1-2 (about 60 SLAB OF HUON PINE sold lots Sep 2025 to Jan 2026 plus Oct 2026 batch: typical $25-120, top about $140-170, median about $60). One WebSearch for retail Huon pine slab prices. Not tried: eBay sold listings (closed to us); would show sold prices for rough Huon slabs and settle retail resale value.
chrome_hint: eBay sold: huon pine slab live edge (rough sawn, Tasmania pickup) to see what private buyers pay; optional only.
viewing_check: Measure length, width and thickness (thickness drives value most). Check how deep the central rot/bark seam goes and whether it splits the slab, look for birdseye or figure on the faces, check for borer and cracks at the ends, and confirm it really is Huon pine (smell, fine pin flecks).
rate_note: All AUD, no conversion. Gowans hammers exclude the 19.8% premium.
